rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for launching a song, product, or package again.

example.english: This snack was so popular that the company decided to reissue it.
example.traditional: 呢款零食咁受歡迎，廠商決定再推出。
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 ling4 sik6 gam3 sau6 fun1 jing4 cong2 soeng1 kyut3 ding6 zoi3 teoi1 ceot1

rows.note: Use this for an official re-release of recorded music, publications, or other issued material.

example.english: The record company will reissue this classic album next month.
example.traditional: 唱片公司下月會重新發行呢張經典專輯。
example.jyutping: coeng3 pin2 gung1 si1 haa6 jyut6 wui5 cung4 san1 faat3 hong4 ne1 zoeng1 ging1 din2 zyun1 cap1

rows.note: Use this specifically when stamps or other printed items are printed again from existing plates.

example.english: The post office decided to reissue this set of stamps using the old plates.
example.traditional: 郵政署決定用返舊版重印呢套郵票。
example.jyutping: jau4 zing3 syu5 kyut3 ding6 jung6 faan2 gau6 baan2 cung4 jan3 ne1 tou3 jau4 piu3
